subject: Developer Demo Sprint — RSVP & tracking links

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Developer Demo Sprint — RSVP & tracking links

Hi Josh —

Hope you’re well. We’re running a short Developer Demo Sprint on Sept 9 (30–45 minutes) focused on inference performance for mid-market analytics platforms — short hands-on walkthrough and live benchmarking using a sample FinLytics workload.

Why this might be useful: you’ll see throughput/latency tradeoffs for 1) hosted vs dedicated endpoints and 2) batching/kv-cache presets. We’ll also share practical UTM and tracking patterns if you want to stitch this to your GA/segment funnels.

Quick asks:
- Can you RSVP for the 9/9 10:00–10:45 PT slot? RSVP link: https://redwood.example.com/rsvp?event=dev-sprint-0909&utm_source=finlytics&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=devsprint
- If you want the team to pre-run the FinLytics sample, please reply with a short sample (1–2 paragraphs) of your average request length and top-3 prompts.

Attached: demo-brief.pdf (agenda + sample payloads) and campaign-utm-matrix.csv (recommended tracking parameters).

If this is better for a cohort of engineers instead of a single attendee, happy to open additional seats — just tell me names.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0124
Redwood Inference

Hi Monica —

Thanks — this looks interesting. I can attend the 9/9 10:00 PT slot. I’ll bring our senior infra engineer Aisha (cc’d). Two quick Qs: 1) Is there any cost to run the sample with our payloads? 2) Will you be sending calendar invites that our team can accept?

Also, we prefer links that directly populate our internal tracking query params (we use utm_source/utm_campaign but also add a custom param fin_cohort). Can you confirm the RSVP link supports adding extra query params?

Best,
Josh

- RSVP link needs to accept and persist extra query params (we use utm matrix attached). If devs add fin_cohort=team-alpha it should be stored on the attendee record. Link: https://redwood.example.com/rsvp?event=dev-sprint-0909&utm_source=finlytics&utm_campaign=devsprint

- We'll send two reminders: 72 hours and 3 hours before. Reminders should include an invite to a post-demo office hours drop-in.
- Track RSVP → attended conversion in HubSpot: deal HL-4321; map utm params to contact properties.

Ben: can you handle the invite + confirm whether we should offer a light free evaluation run (no charge, limited tokens) or route to sales for a credit? If we offer a free run, we need a one-off dev token and a note in HubSpot.

Thanks — Monica

I’ve updated the campaign-utm-matrix.csv to include fin_cohort in the sample rows and uploaded the revised CSV to Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2b3C-demo-brief (revised).
